--// PLAYMEGAMARBLE MENU
--// Put this LocalScript inside StarterGui

--------------------------------------------------
-- SETTINGS
--------------------------------------------------

local jumpPower = 50

local flying = false
local noclip = false
local espEnabled = false
local infiniteJump = false

local flyConnection
local noclipConnection

local flingCooldown = {}

--------------------------------------------------
-- COLORS
--------------------------------------------------

navigation.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 55)
navigation.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")

	button.Size = UDim2.new(1/3, -5, 1, 0)
	button.Position = position
	button.Text = text
	button.TextScaled = true
	button.Parent = navigation

	style(button)

	return button
end

local homeTab = makeTab(
	"HOME",
	UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
)

local miscTab = makeTab(

	UDim2.new(1/3, 2.5, 0, 0)

--------------------------------------------------

	page.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 105)

end

local homePage = makePage()

--------------------------------------------------

flySpeedLabel.TextColor3 = WHITE

flySpeedLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
flySpeedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1

--------------------------------------------------

	showPage(homePage)

	showPage(creditsPage)

--------------------------------------------------
-- MOVEMENT
--------------------------------------------------

local function applyMovement()

	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end

	local humanoid =
		character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if humanoid then

		humanoid.WalkSpeed = walkSpeed
		humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
		humanoid.JumpPower = jumpPower

	end
end

speedButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	local value = tonumber(speedBox.Text)

	if value then

		walkSpeed = math.clamp(value, 0, 250)
		speedBox.Text = tostring(walkSpeed)

		applyMovement()

	end
end)

jumpButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	local value = tonumber(jumpBox.Text)

	if value then

		jumpPower = math.clamp(value, 0, 250)
		jumpBox.Text = tostring(jumpPower)

		applyMovement()

	end
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- INFINITE JUMP
--------------------------------------------------

UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()

	if not infiniteJump then return end

	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end

	local humanoid =
		character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if humanoid then
		humanoid:ChangeState(
			Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
		)
	end

end)

infiniteJumpButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	infiniteJump = not infiniteJump

	infiniteJumpButton.Text =
		"InFINITE JUMP: " ..
		(infiniteJump and "ON" or "OFF")

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- FLY
-- LOOK DIRECTION + WASD / MOBILE JOYSTICK
--------------------------------------------------

local function stopFlying()

	flying = false
	flyButton.Text = "FLY: OFF"

	if flyConnection then

		flyConnection:Disconnect()
		flyConnection = nil

	end

	local character = player.Character

	if character then

		local humanoid =
			character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if humanoid then

			humanoid.PlatformStand = false
			humanoid.AutoRotate = true

		end
	end
end

local function startFlying()

	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end

	local root =
		character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	local humanoid =
		character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	flying = true
	flyButton.Text = "FLY: ON"

	humanoid.PlatformStand = true
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false

	flyConnection =
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

			if not flying or not root.Parent then

				stopFlying()
				return

			end

			local moveDirection =
				humanoid.MoveDirection

			if moveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then

				local camera =
					workspace.CurrentCamera

				local lookDirection =
					camera.CFrame.LookVector

				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
					lookDirection.Unit * flySpeed

				root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
					root.Position,
					root.Position + lookDirection
				)

			else

				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
					Vector3.zero

			end

		end)
end

flyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	if flying then
		stopFlying()
	else
		startFlying()
	end

end)

flySpeedBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()

	local value = tonumber(flySpeedBox.Text)

	if value then

		flySpeed =
			math.clamp(value, 1, 250)

		flySpeedBox.Text =
			tostring(flySpeed)

	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- ESP
--------------------------------------------------

local function getHealthColor(health, maxHealth)

	if health <= 0 then
		return Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 255)

	end

	local percentage =
		health / maxHealth

	if percentage <= 0.25 then

		return Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)

	elseif percentage <= 0.50 then

		return Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)

	else

		return Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)

	end
end

local function addESP(target)

	if target == player then return end

	local character =
		target.Character

	if not character then return end

	local humanoid =
		character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if not humanoid then return end

	if espObjects[target] then
		return
	end

	local highlight =
		Instance.new("Highlight")

	highlight.Adornee = character
	highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
	highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
	highlight.Parent = character

	local billboard =
		Instance.new("BillboardGui")

	billboard.Size =
		UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 45)

	billboard.StudsOffset =
		Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)

	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.Adornee = character
	billboard.Parent = character

	local label =
		Instance.new("TextLabel")

	label.Size =
		UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)

	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.Parent = billboard

	local function updateESP()

		local health =
			math.max(0, humanoid.Health)

		local maxHealth =
			humanoid.MaxHealth

		local color =
			getHealthColor(
				health,
				maxHealth
			)

		label.Text =
			target.Name ..
			" [" ..
			math.floor(health) ..
			"/" ..
			math.floor(maxHealth) ..
			"]"

		label.TextColor3 = color

		highlight.FillColor = color
		highlight.OutlineColor = RED

	end

	updateESP()

	local connection =
		humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(
			updateESP
		)

	espObjects[target] = {

		highlight = highlight,
		billboard = billboard,
		connection = connection

	}

end

local function removeESP(target)

	local data =
		espObjects[target]

	if not data then return end

	if data.connection then
		data.connection:Disconnect()
	end

	if data.highlight then
		data.highlight:Destroy()
	end

	if data.billboard then
		data.billboard:Destroy()
	end

	espObjects[target] = nil

end

local function enableESP()

	espEnabled = true
	espButton.Text = "ESP: ON"

	for _, target in
		ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

		addESP(target)

	end
end

local function disableESP()

	espEnabled = false
	espButton.Text = "ESP: OFF"

	for _, target in
		ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

		removeESP(target)

	end
end

espButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	if espEnabled then
		disableESP()
	else
		enableESP()
	end

end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(target)

	target.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

		if espEnabled then

			task.wait(0.5)
			addESP(target)

		end

	end)

end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(target)

	removeESP(target)

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- NOCLIP
--------------------------------------------------

local function setNoclip(enabled)

	noclip = enabled

	noclipButton.Text =
		"NOCLIP: " ..
		(enabled and "ON" or "OFF")

	if noclipConnection then

		noclipConnection:Disconnect()
		noclipConnection = nil

	end

	if enabled then

		noclipConnection =
			RunService.Stepped:Connect(
				function()

					local character =
						player.Character

					if not character then
						return
					end

					for _, part in
						ipairs(
							character:GetDescendants()
						) do

						if part:IsA("BasePart") then
							part.CanCollide = false
						end

					end

				end
			)

	end
end

noclipButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	setNoclip(not noclip)

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- WALK FLING
--------------------------------------------------

local function flingTarget(target)

	if not walkFling then return end

	local character =
		target.Character

	if not character then return end

	local targetRoot =
		character:FindFirstChild(
			"HumanoidRootPart"
		)

	local myCharacter =
		player.Character

	if not myCharacter or not targetRoot then
		return
	end

	local myRoot =
		myCharacter:FindFirstChild(
			"HumanoidRootPart"
		)

	if not myRoot then return end

	if flingCooldown[target] then
		return
	end

	flingCooldown[target] = true

	local direction =
		targetRoot.Position -
		myRoot.Position

	if direction.Magnitude > 0 then

		direction =
			direction.Unit

		targetRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
			direction * 100 +
			Vector3.new(0, 60, 0)

	end

	task.delay(0.5, function()

		flingCooldown[target] = nil

	end)

end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

	if not walkFling then return end

	local character =
		player.Character

	if not character then return end

	local root =
		character:FindFirstChild(
			"HumanoidRootPart"
		)

	if not root then return end

	for _, target in
		ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

		if target ~= player then

			local targetCharacter =
				target.Character

			if targetCharacter then

				local targetRoot =
					targetCharacter:FindFirstChild(
						"HumanoidRootPart"
					)

				if targetRoot then

					local distance =
						(
							root.Position -
							targetRoot.Position
						).Magnitude

					if distance <= 4 then
						flingTarget(target)
					end

				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

flingButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	walkFling = not walkFling

	flingButton.Text =
		"WALK FLING: " ..
		(walkFling and "ON" or "OFF")

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- MINIMIZE
--------------------------------------------------

minimize.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	menu.Visible = false
	reopen.Visible = true

end)

reopen.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	menu.Visible = true
	reopen.Visible = false

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- DRAGGING
--------------------------------------------------

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

title.Active = true

title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true

		dragStart =
			input.Position

		startPosition =
			menu.Position

		input.Changed:Connect(function()

			if input.UserInputState ==
				Enum.UserInputState.End then

				dragging = false

			end

		end)

	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if not dragging then return end

	if input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		local delta =
			input.Position -
			dragStart

		menu.Position =
			UDim2.new(
				startPosition.X.Scale,
				startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPosition.Y.Scale,
				startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)

	end
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- RESPAWN
--------------------------------------------------

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

	task.wait(0.5)

	applyMovement()

	if noclip then
		setNoclip(true)
	end

	if espEnabled then

		for _, target in
			ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

			if target ~= player then
				addESP(target)
			end

		end

	end
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- KEEP MOVEMENT
--------------------------------------------------

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

	local character =
		player.Character

	if not character then return end

	local humanoid =
		character:FindFirstChildOfClass(
			"Humanoid"
		)

	if humanoid then

		humanoid.WalkSpeed =
			walkSpeed

		humanoid.UseJumpPower = true

		humanoid.JumpPower =
			jumpPower

	end
end)

-- LocalScript inside StarterPlayer -> StarterPlayerScripts
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
	Name = "Ultimate Fly Script",
	LoadingTitle = "Fly Utility",
	LoadingSubtitle = "ISOXTERIA",
	ConfigurationSaving = {
		Enabled = true,
		FolderName = "AIMBOT",
		FileName = "FlyConfig"
	},
	Discord = { Enabled = false },
	KeySystem = false
})

local FlightTab = Window:CreateTab("Flight Controls", 4483362458)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Flying = false
local FlySpeed = 50
local BoostMultiplier = 2.5
local BoostCooldown = 1.2
local CanBoost = true
local NoclipWhileFlying = false
local EnableAnimations = true
local EnableTrail = true
local DynamicFOV = true

local Attachment, LinearVelocity, AlignOrientation
local CurrentVelocity = Vector3.zero
local TargetVelocity = Vector3.zero
local CurrentLean = 0
local CurrentTilt = 0
local CurrentRoll = 0
local BobTimer = 0

local TrailInstance = nil
local Attachment0, Attachment1
local DefaultFOV = 70

-- Dynamic Universal Arm Joint Variables (Supports R6, R15 & Custom Rigs)
local LeftShoulder, RightShoulder
local OriginalLeftC0, OriginalRightC0
local CurrentChar = nil

local function getCharacterParts()
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if char then
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or root
		return char, hum, root, torso
	end
	return nil, nil, nil, nil
end

-- Universal Joint Finder (Scans Rig Structure for Shoulders)
local function SetupArmJoints()
	local char = getCharacterParts()
	if not char then return end

	-- Clear previous references if character reset
	if char ~= CurrentChar then
		CurrentChar = char
		LeftShoulder = nil
		RightShoulder = nil
		OriginalLeftC0 = nil
		OriginalRightC0 = nil
	end

	if LeftShoulder and RightShoulder then return end

	-- Dynamic Search across all descendants for Motor6D Shoulder Joints
	for _, v in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("Motor6D") then
			local name = v.Name:lower()
			if (name:find("left") or name:find("l_")) and (name:find("shoulder") or name:find("arm")) then
				if not LeftShoulder then LeftShoulder = v end
			elseif (name:find("right") or name:find("r_")) and (name:find("shoulder") or name:find("arm")) then
				if not RightShoulder then RightShoulder = v end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Fallback check for standard Roblox Rig naming
	if not LeftShoulder then
		LeftShoulder = char:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder", true) or char:FindFirstChild("LeftShoulder", true)
	end
	if not RightShoulder then
		RightShoulder = char:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder", true) or char:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder", true)
	end

	-- Cache original C0 positions
	if LeftShoulder and not OriginalLeftC0 then
		OriginalLeftC0 = LeftShoulder.C0
	end
	if RightShoulder and not OriginalRightC0 then
		OriginalRightC0 = RightShoulder.C0
	end
end

local function ResetArmJoints()
	if LeftShoulder and OriginalLeftC0 then
		TweenService:Create(LeftShoulder, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {C0 = OriginalLeftC0}):Play()
	end
	if RightShoulder and OriginalRightC0 then
		TweenService:Create(RightShoulder, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {C0 = OriginalRightC0}):Play()
	end
end

	local char, humanoid, rootPart = getCharacterParts()
	if not rootPart or not LinearVelocity or not AlignOrientation then return end

	if NoclipWhileFlying and char then
		for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.CanCollide = false
			end
		end
	end

	local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	local rawDir = Vector3.zero

	local isW = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W)
	local isS = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S)
	local isA = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A)
	local isD = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D)

	if isW then rawDir = rawDir + Camera.CFrame.LookVector end
	if isS then rawDir = rawDir - Camera.CFrame.LookVector end
	if isA then rawDir = rawDir - Camera.CFrame.RightVector end
	if isD then rawDir = rawDir + Camera.CFrame.RightVector end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then rawDir = rawDir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end

	-- Smooth Velocity Calculation
	if rawDir.Magnitude > 0 then
		TargetVelocity = rawDir.Unit * FlySpeed
	else
		TargetVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end

	CurrentVelocity = CurrentVelocity:Lerp(TargetVelocity, math.clamp(deltaTime * 8, 0, 1))

	-- Advanced Multi-Axis Hovering Idle Animation
	BobTimer = BobTimer + deltaTime * 2.5
	local bobOffset = Vector3.zero
	local hoverJitter = Vector3.zero

	if rawDir.Magnitude == 0 and EnableAnimations then
		bobOffset = Vector3.new(
			math.cos(BobTimer * 0.8) * 0.35,
			math.sin(BobTimer * 1.5) * 0.6,
			math.sin(BobTimer * 0.5) * 0.25
		)
	elseif EnableAnimations and CurrentVelocity.Magnitude > 100 then
		-- High-speed subtle micro-vibrations for wind effect
		hoverJitter = Vector3.new(
			(math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1,
			(math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1,
			(math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1
		)
	end

	LinearVelocity.VectorVelocity = CurrentVelocity + bobOffset + hoverJitter

	-- Universal Superman Arm Pose Animation
	ApplySupermanPose(isW)

	-- Dynamic Speed FOV
	if DynamicFOV then
		local currentSpeedRatio = CurrentVelocity.Magnitude / 1000
		local targetFOV = math.clamp(DefaultFOV + (currentSpeedRatio * 35), DefaultFOV, 110)
		Camera.FieldOfView = Camera.FieldOfView + (targetFOV - Camera.FieldOfView) * math.clamp(deltaTime * 5, 0, 1)
	end

	-- Overhauled Body Pitching, Banking & Rolling Physics
	local targetLean = 0
	local targetTilt = 0
	local targetRoll = 0

	if EnableAnimations then
		if isW then 
			targetLean = math.rad(-80) -- Full horizontal Superman stance
		end
		if isS then 
			targetLean = math.rad(30) 
		end
		if isA then 
			targetTilt = math.rad(22)
			targetRoll = math.rad(-25) -- Banking roll into turns
		end
		if isD then 
			targetTilt = math.rad(-22)
			targetRoll = math.rad(25) -- Banking roll into turns
		end
	end

	CurrentLean = CurrentLean + (targetLean - CurrentLean) * math.clamp(deltaTime * 9, 0, 1)
	CurrentTilt = CurrentTilt + (targetTilt - CurrentTilt) * math.clamp(deltaTime * 9, 0, 1)
	CurrentRoll = CurrentRoll + (targetRoll - CurrentRoll) * math.clamp(deltaTime * 9, 0, 1)

	local camLook = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local flatLook = Vector3.new(camLook.X, 0, camLook.Z)

	if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then
		local baseCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(rootPart.Position, rootPart.Position + camLook)
		AlignOrientation.CFrame = baseCFrame * CFrame.Angles(CurrentLean, CurrentRoll, CurrentTilt)
	end
end)

local function toggleAim()
	aimOn = not aimOn

	if aimOn then
		aimTarget = getNearestPlayer()
	else
		aimTarget = nil
	end

	setVisual(aimBtn, aimStroke, aimOn)
end

local function toggleChar()
	charOn = not charOn

	local char = plr.Character
	local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if charOn then
		charTarget = getNearestPlayer()

		if humanoid then
			oldAutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate
			humanoid.AutoRotate = false
		end
	else
		charTarget = nil

		if humanoid and oldAutoRotate ~= nil then
			humanoid.AutoRotate = oldAutoRotate
		end

		oldAutoRotate = nil
	end

	setVisual(charBtn, charStroke, charOn)
end

local function startSystem()
	aimBtn, aimStroke = makeButton("Aimlock", "Aimlock", -148, toggleAim)
	charBtn, charStroke = makeButton("Charlock", "Charlock", -98, toggleChar)

	RS:BindToRenderStep(
		"LockSystem",
		Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1,
		function()
			cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

			if aimOn then
				local torso = getTorso(aimTarget)

				if not torso then
					aimOn = false
					aimTarget = nil
					setVisual(aimBtn, aimStroke, false)
				else
					local focus = cam.Focus.Position
					local dist = (cam.CFrame.Position - focus).Magnitude
					local dir = torso.Position - focus

					if dir.Magnitude > 0.1 then
						local cameraPosition =
							focus
							- dir.Unit * dist
							+ Vector3.new(0, OffsetU, 0)
							+ cam.CFrame.RightVector * OffsetD

						cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
							cameraPosition,
							torso.Position
						)
					end
				end
			end

			if charOn then
				local char = plr.Character
				local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local torso = getTorso(charTarget)

				if not root or not torso then
					charOn = false
					charTarget = nil
					setVisual(charBtn, charStroke, false)

					local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

					if humanoid and oldAutoRotate ~= nil then
						humanoid.AutoRotate = oldAutoRotate
					end

					oldAutoRotate = nil
				else
					local targetPos = Vector3.new(
						torso.Position.X,
						root.Position.Y,
						torso.Position.Z
					)

					if (targetPos - root.Position).Magnitude > 0.01 then
						root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
							root.Position,
							targetPos
						)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	)

	P.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
		if p == aimTarget then
			aimOn = false
			aimTarget = nil
			setVisual(aimBtn, aimStroke, false)
		end

		if p == charTarget then
			charOn = false
			charTarget = nil
			setVisual(charBtn, charStroke, false)

			local char = plr.Character
			local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if humanoid and oldAutoRotate ~= nil then
				humanoid.AutoRotate = oldAutoRotate
			end

			oldAutoRotate = nil
		end
	end)

	plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		aimOn = false
		charOn = false
		aimTarget = nil
		charTarget = nil

		setVisual(aimBtn, aimStroke, false)
		setVisual(charBtn, charStroke, false)

		oldAutoRotate = nil
	end)
end

	if loaded then

	loaded = true

	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local Players = game.Players
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer

	local function setupCollision(character)
		local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local bodyParts = {}

		hrp.CanCollide = true

		local function addPart(part)
			if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= hrp then
				table.insert(bodyParts, part)
			end
		end

		for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			addPart(part)
		end

		local heartbeatConnection
		heartbeatConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

				descendantConnection:Disconnect()
				return
			end

				local p = bodyParts[i]
				if p and p.Parent then
					p.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	if player.Character then
		setupCollision(player.Character)
	end

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupCollision)
end)

do
	local dragging = false

	title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			local abs = main.AbsolutePosition
			offset = Vector2.new(input.Position.X - abs.X, input.Position.Y - abs.Y)
		end
	end)

	flying = false
	if bv then bv:Destroy() bv = nil end

	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 180, 80)
end

	if not root or not root.Parent then getChar() end
	if not root then return end
	flying = true
	bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
	bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bv.Parent = root
	bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
	bg.P = 1e4
	bg.Parent = root
	humanoid.PlatformStand = true
	btn.Text = "DESATIVAR FLY"
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60)
end

btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if flying then stopFly() else startFly() end
end)

RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not flying or not bv or not bg or not root or not root.Parent then return end

	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local look = cam.CFrame.LookVector
	local right = cam.CFrame.RightVector
	local move = Vector3.zero

	-- teclado: W = onde olha
	if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then move += look end
	if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then move -= look end
	if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then move -= right end
	if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then move += right end

	-- joystick: direção certa (não invertida)
	if humanoid then
		local md = humanoid.MoveDirection
		if md.Magnitude > 0.05 then
			local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
			local flatRight = Vector3.new(right.X, 0, right.Z)
			if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.01 then flatLook = flatLook.Unit end
			if flatRight.Magnitude > 0.01 then flatRight = flatRight.Unit end

			local frente = md:Dot(flatLook)
			local lado = md:Dot(flatRight)

			-- frente do joystick = direção da câmera (sobe se olhar pra cima)
			move += look * frente + right * lado
		end
	end

	bv.Velocity = move.Magnitude > 0 and move.Unit * flySpeed or Vector3.zero
	bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame
end)

local sliding = false

	local x = track.AbsolutePosition.X
	local w = track.AbsoluteSize.X
	if w > 0 then setSpeed((pos.X - x) / w) end
end

track.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
	if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		sliding = true

	end
end)
thumb.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
	if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		sliding = true
	end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
	if sliding and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		fromInput(i.Position)
	end
end)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
	if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		sliding = false
	end
end)

	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local Players = game.Players

	local function setupCollision(character)
		local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local bodyParts = {}

		hrp.CanCollide = true

		local function addPart(part)
			if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= hrp then
				table.insert(bodyParts, part)
			end
		end

		for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			addPart(part)
		end

		local descendantConnection = character.DescendantAdded:Connect(addPart)

		local heartbeatConnection
		heartbeatConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			if not character or not character.Parent then
				heartbeatConnection:Disconnect()
				descendantConnection:Disconnect()
				return
			end

				local p = bodyParts[i]
				if p and p.Parent then
					p.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	if player.Character then
		setupCollision(player.Character)
	end

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupCollision)
end)

scripts.features:
PulseCore Place Saver

PulseCore Place Saver is a lightweight Roblox utility script for saving the current place using the executor's `saveinstance` functionality.

Before saving, PulseCore displays a confirmation window explaining that the game may temporarily freeze while the place is being processed. The user can choose whether to continue or cancel the operation.

Features

Place Saver

Save the current Roblox place with `saveinstance`.

* Full place saving
* Script decompilation when supported
* Automatically generated filenames
* Uses the current Place ID and timestamp in the filename
* Manual saving with `RightShift`

Startup Confirmation

A PulseCore-styled confirmation window appears when the script starts.

It warns that the game may temporarily freeze during the save process.

`Continue` — Starts the place save.

`Cancel` — Cancels the operation and completely stops the script.

Roblox Notifications

Uses Roblox's built-in notification system instead of a custom notification GUI.

Notifications are shown for:

* Script loaded
* Save started
* Save completed
* Save failed
* Script cancelled
* Missing `saveinstance

Error Handling

The save operation is protected with error handling so failures can be reported through Roblox notifications without silently stopping the script.

Controls

`RightShift` — Save the current place again.

Requirements

The script requires an executor with a working `saveinstance` function.

Available `saveinstance` features and parameters may vary depending on the executor.

function FindTextOnScripts(Ancestor, TextToFind)
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local FPS = 0
    local Frames = 0
    local LastTime = os.clock()
    local Connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        Frames += 1
        local Now = os.clock()
        if Now - LastTime >= 1 then
            FPS = Frames / (Now - LastTime)
            Frames = 0
            LastTime = Now
        end
    end)

    local function IsTextOnScript(Script, TextToFind)
        local Success, Text = pcall(decompile, Script)
        if not Success or type(Text) ~= "string" then
            return false
        end
        return Text:find(TextToFind, 1, true) ~= nil
    end

    local function FindTextOnScripts(Ancestor, TextToFind)
        print("Starting to read scripts")
        local Scripts = {}
        for _, Script in ipairs(Ancestor:GetDescendants()) do
            if Script:IsA("Script") or Script:IsA("LocalScript") or Script:IsA("ModuleScript") then
                if Script.ClassName ~= "Script" or Script.ClassName == "Script" and Script.RunContext == Enum.RunContext.Client then
                    table.insert(Scripts, Script)
                end
            end
        end
        print("Found " .. #Scripts .. " Scripts.")
        for i, Script in ipairs(Scripts) do
            if Script:IsA("Script") or Script:IsA("LocalScript") or Script:IsA("ModuleScript") then
                if Script.ClassName ~= "Script" or Script.ClassName == "Script" and Script.RunContext == Enum.RunContext.Client then
                    if IsTextOnScript(Script, "Humanoid") then
                        print("Found TT on: " .. Script:GetFullName())
                    end
                end
            end
            repeat task.wait() until FPS > 5
            if i % 100 == 0 then
                print("Looked at " .. i .. "Scripts.")
            end
        end
        print("Done.")
    end
    FindTextOnScripts(Ancestor, TextToFind)
    Connection:Disconnect()
end
